initials.doc: Fallback initials when no image is available

Avatar.notes: forwardRef<HTMLDivElement>. Fallback chain: image (until onError) -> initials (first 2 chars uppercased) -> fallback node -> default person SVG. Shape is called `variant` here.

dot.doc: Adds a dot indicator before the content

Badge.notes: forwardRef<HTMLSpanElement>. Props in Badge.types.ts. Status colors folded into `variant` (success/warning/error).

isLoading.doc: Shows loading spinner and disables interaction

isFullWidth.doc: Makes button take full width of container

isIconOnly.doc: Renders button as icon-only (square aspect ratio)

leftIcon.doc: Icon to display before button text

rightIcon.doc: Icon to display after button text

Button.notes: forwardRef<HTMLButtonElement>; renders motion.button (hover scale 1.02 / tap 0.98, disabled under reduced motion). disabled || isLoading => disabled + aria-disabled; aria-busy=isLoading. Explicitly destructures/forwards common handlers, form* attrs and aria-* then spreads rest (undefined values filtered). className merged via cn(); style passed through. Types live in Button.types.ts (ButtonVariant, ButtonSize).

children.doc: Button group content (Button or LinkButton components)

size.doc: Size applied to all buttons in the group

isAttached.doc: Whether buttons should be visually connected

isFullWidth.doc: Whether the group should take full width

spacing.doc: Spacing between buttons when not attached

ButtonGroup.notes: forwardRef<HTMLDivElement>. size is applied via CSS class on the group (not cloned into children). Rest spread onto div.

underlineOnHover.doc: Whether to show underline only on hover

LinkComponent.type: ComponentType<{ to: string; className?: string; target?: string; rel?: string; children: ReactNode }>
LinkComponent.doc: Optional router-aware link component (e.g. TanStack Router's `Link`). When provided, renders this instead of a plain `<a>` and forwards `to` / `className` / `target` / `rel` so client-side navigation works.

to.doc: Internal route path. Required when `LinkComponent` is provided; otherwise `href` is used.

Link.notes: forwardRef<HTMLAnchorElement> (ref only applied to the plain <a> path, NOT to LinkComponent). Router injection via LinkComponent+to (a light polymorphism alternative to `as`); rest props are dropped in the LinkComponent branch. target="_blank" auto-appends rel="noopener noreferrer".

isFullWidth.doc: Makes button take full width of container

isIconOnly.doc: Renders button as icon-only (square aspect ratio)

LinkButton.notes: forwardRef<HTMLAnchorElement>; motion.a with Button.module.scss styles. No isLoading/disabled. Auto rel=noopener noreferrer for target=_blank. No LinkComponent router support (unlike Link).

icon.doc: The Lucide icon component to render

size.doc: Size of the icon (maps to 12/16/20/24/32/48 px)

label.doc: Accessible label (sets aria-label, makes icon non-decorative)

Icon.notes: forwardRef<SVGSVGElement>. Takes a component reference (icon={Home}), not an element. aria-hidden unless label given (then role=img). Coupled to lucide-react.

Skeleton.notes: forwardRef<HTMLDivElement>. Numeric width/height -> px, merged over style. Always aria-hidden.

Spinner.notes: forwardRef<HTMLDivElement>; role=status, aria-label=label plus visually-hidden text.

removable.doc: Whether the tag can be removed

onRemove.doc: Callback when remove button is clicked

removeAriaLabel.doc: Accessible name for the remove button. Defaults to "Remove tag". Override when rendering multiple removable tags so each has a unique name.

Tag.notes: forwardRef<HTMLDivElement> but does NOT extend/spread HTML attrs (no style, id, aria passthrough). Controlled/uncontrolled pair: selected/defaultSelected/onSelectChange(selected: boolean). role=button + aria-pressed when selectable; Delete/Backspace triggers onRemove. avatar wins over leftIcon.

lineClamp.doc: Limit to specific number of lines with ellipsis

Text.notes: Plain function (NO forwardRef). Polymorphic via `as` (loosely typed ElementType; Text.types.ts also exports a TextElement union and a public TextProps interface, but the component uses an internal TextOwnProps). lineClamp sets --line-clamp CSS var.

Checkbox.notes: forwardRef<HTMLInputElement> (merged callback ref also sets node.indeterminate). Native input: checked/defaultChecked/onChange(ChangeEvent) pass through. className goes on the outer container div, rest on <input>. Auto id via useId; description wired to aria-describedby. Enter key toggles.

errorMessage.doc: Error message (replaces helper text when present)

FormField.notes: Plain function, no ref, no HTML passthrough. Label htmlFor=id but does NOT inject id/aria-describedby into children - consumer must pass the same id to the child. Error rendered with role=alert.

FormHint.notes:
Plain function, no ref. Renders

; returns null when hidden. role=alert for error variant. Default icons Info/AlertCircle/CheckCircle2 per variant.

leftElement.doc: Icon or element to display at the start

rightElement.doc: Icon or element to display at the end

Input.notes: forwardRef<HTMLInputElement>. className goes on the wrapper div; rest (value/defaultValue/onChange(ChangeEvent)) on <input>. Adornments named leftElement/rightElement (not *Icon) and are aria-hidden. aria-invalid=isError.

Label.notes: Plain function, no ref, no passthrough. subText rendered in parentheses.

Radio.notes: forwardRef<HTMLInputElement>. Single native radio; there is NO RadioGroup component - grouping via shared `name`, checked/onChange(ChangeEvent) native. className on container.

options.type: SelectOption[]  // { value: string; label: string; disabled?: boolean }

placeholder.doc: Placeholder text when no value selected

Select.notes: forwardRef<HTMLSelectElement>; native <select>, value/defaultValue/onChange(ChangeEvent<HTMLSelectElement>). Data-driven options array. Uses `fullWidth` (not isFullWidth like Input). Built-in label/helper/error (field chrome baked in).

Slider.notes: forwardRef<HTMLInputElement>; native range input. value/defaultValue/onChange(ChangeEvent) native. Displayed value only tracks the `value`/`defaultValue` prop (not live in uncontrolled mode).

Stepper.notes: Plain function, no ref. Controlled-only; onChange receives the clamped number (value, not event). Not a file-level component doc beyond 'numeric input rendered as [-] [value] [+]'.

Switch.notes: forwardRef<HTMLInputElement>; native checkbox (no role=switch). checked/defaultChecked/onChange(ChangeEvent) native. No isError.

TextArea.notes: forwardRef<HTMLTextAreaElement>. Field chrome baked in (label/helper/error). `required` is consumed (only aria-required set, native required attr NOT forwarded). className on wrapper.

leftElement.doc: Icon or element to display at the start

rightElement.doc: Icon or element to display at the end

TextField.notes: forwardRef<HTMLInputElement> forwarded to inner Input. Composition of Input + label/helper/error. className on outer wrapper. required -> aria-required only.

ratio.doc: Aspect ratio as width/height (e.g., 16/9) or preset

AspectRatio.notes: Plain function, no ref, no passthrough. Presets: square 1, video 16/9, portrait 3/4, wide 21/9. Uses padding-bottom hack.

onContextMenu.doc: Context-menu (right-click) handler — e.g. canvas nodes with a custom menu

Card.notes: Plain function, no ref, no HTML passthrough (aria/id dropped). Polymorphic `as`. interactive => role=button + tabIndex=0 (but no keyboard activation handler). Sub-parts are separate named exports (CardHeader/CardBody/CardFooter), NOT dot-attached Card.Header.

name.doc: Editorial card name. When provided alongside `meta`, renders the spec-style header: serif name on the left (supports `<em>` accent), uppercase mono caption on the right. Falls back to `children` otherwise.

meta.doc: Uppercase mono caption rendered on the right of the spec header.

CardHeader.notes: Sub-component of Card. Two render modes: spec header (name/meta) vs plain children.

Container.notes: Plain function, polymorphic `as`, no ref, no rest passthrough.

Divider.notes: Plain function. Renders <hr> when horizontal and unlabeled, else div (vertical divider has no role=separator).

columns.doc: Number of columns — supports responsive object e.g. `{{ base: 1, md: 3 }}`

gap.doc: Gap between items — supports responsive object.

containerQuery.doc: When set, the component applies container-type: inline-size and responsive CSS vars respond to @container queries at the given size threshold.

animate.doc: Enable stagger animation for grid items

staggerDelay.doc: Stagger delay between items in seconds

Grid.notes: Plain function, no ref, no style/rest passthrough. Polymorphic `as` (ignored when animate: renders motion.div wrapping each child). Responsive values become CSS custom props (--grid-columns-{bp}, --grid-gap-{bp}). columns typed as string literals though JSDoc example uses numbers. Grid.Item = GridItem (dot-attached).

Grid.Item.notes: Static property `Grid.Item = GridItem`; same props as GridItem.

GridItem.extends: Record<string, unknown> (intersection; arbitrary props spread onto element)

span.doc: Number of columns to span. "full" = span all 12 columns (1 / -1). Supports responsive object e.g. `{ base: 12, md: 6 }`

start.doc: Column start position (1-indexed). Supports responsive object.

GridItem.notes: Also exposed as Grid.Item. Polymorphic `as`; rest spread (so aria-label etc. work) but style is overwritten by the span/start CSS vars. PageShell detects it via displayName === "GridItem".

eyebrow.doc: Small mono label above the title (e.g. "Campaigns · 04 total").

title.doc:
Main page heading. Accepts JSX so callers can inline `` or `
` accents.

description.doc: Sublede paragraph shown below the title.

style.doc: Inline styles — useful for ad-hoc token overrides.

PageHero.notes: Plain function; <header> with <h1>. Slot props (eyebrow/title/description/actions); styled via --page-hero-* CSS vars.

variant.doc: Layout variant. default — max-width 1280px; narrow — 1024px (auth-style); full — no max-width.

children.doc: Page content. Direct children that are not GridItem are auto-wrapped in `<GridItem span={{ base: 12 }}>`.

animate.doc: Enable stagger animation for page sections

PageShell.notes: Wraps Grid columns="12"; auto-wraps non-GridItem children. Do not nest. `animate` here is a CSS fade class, not Grid's stagger.

pageKey.doc: Unique key for the current page/content - change this to trigger transition

duration.doc: Transition duration in seconds. Defaults to the theme's normal duration token.

PageTransition.notes: AnimatePresence mode=wait + motion.div keyed by pageKey. Reduced motion => duration 0.

eyebrow.doc: Mono uppercase label above the title — e.g. "CAMPAIGNS · 4 TOTAL".

title.doc: Section heading text. Rendered as an `<h2>` by default.

description.doc: Optional description line below the title. Max 62ch.

actions.doc: Right-aligned action slot — usually a Button or Dropdown.

size.doc: Size variant. md — title at --font-size-md (16px); sm — --font-size-base (15px).

as.doc: Override the rendered heading element. Defaults to "h2".

className.doc: Additional class name on the root element.

SectionHeader.notes: `as` changes the HEADING element, not the root (<header>). Eyebrow aria-hidden. Unlike PageHero, slots are strings not ReactNode (except actions).

direction.doc: Flex direction — supports responsive object e.g. `{{ base: "column", md: "row" }}`

gap.doc: Gap between items — supports responsive object

wrap.doc: Allow items to wrap — supports responsive object

containerQuery.doc: When set, the component applies container-type: inline-size and responsive CSS vars respond to @container queries at the given size threshold.

animate.doc: Enable stagger animation for stack items

staggerDelay.doc: Stagger delay between items in seconds

Stack.notes: Plain function, no ref, no rest passthrough. Polymorphic `as` (ignored when animate). All layout props responsive via --stack-* CSS vars; style merged last.

columns.type: DataGridColumn<T>[]  // { id: string; header: ReactNode; cell: (row: T) => ReactNode; width?: string | number; sortable?: boolean; sortFn?: (a: T, b: T) => number; align?: "left" | "center" | "right" }

DataGrid.notes: Generic <T>. Sort state and page state are INTERNAL (uncontrolled, no callbacks); selection is controlled-only via selectedIds Set + onSelectionChange(Set). Default sort compares String(cell(row)). Composes Checkbox, Pagination, Spinner. Exports its own SortDirection type (duplicate of Table's).

columns.type: DataTableColumn<T>[]  // { id: string; header: string; cell: (row: T, index: number) => ReactNode; width?: string; align?: "left" | "right" }

loading.doc: Whether to show a skeleton loading state

loadingRowCount.doc: Number of skeleton rows to render while loading

emptyState.doc: Content to render when data is empty and not loading

onRowClick.doc: Optional click handler — rows become focusable buttons

className.doc: Additional class for the outer wrapper

DataTable.notes: Generic <T>. Div-based ARIA table (role=table/row/cell) using CSS grid --dt-cols. Data-driven columns with cell render function. Clickable rows rendered as <button role=row>. Row key fn is `getRowKey` here vs `getRowId` in DataGrid; `density` concept only here.

EmptyState.notes: Plain function; title is an <h3>. Slot props.

items.type: FilterTabItem[]  // { id: string; label: string; count?: number; icon?: ReactNode }

FilterTabs.notes: Controlled-only, onChange(value). role=tablist/tab without roving tabindex or arrow keys. Counts zero-padded to 2 digits.

animate.doc: Enable stagger animation for list items

List.notes: Plain function, <ul>. Sub-parts are separate named exports. When animate, wraps each child in motion.div inside <ul> (invalid li nesting).

ListGroup.notes: Sub-component of List; <li> containing label + nested <ul>.

ListItem.notes: Sub-component of List. Interactive (role=button, tabIndex 0, Enter/Space) only when onClick provided. Slot naming leading/trailing (vs leftIcon/rightIcon elsewhere).

numericValue.doc: Numeric value for count-up animation (overrides value when provided)

formatValue.doc: Format function for numeric value (e.g., to add currency symbol)

footer.doc: Optional footer content rendered below the value row

StatCard.notes: Renders <button> when onClick given, else <div> (implicit polymorphism). `value` is required even when numericValue is used. Spring count-up via motion useSpring.

minWidth.doc: Minimum width for responsive horizontal scroll

Table.notes: Composable semantic <table> wrapped in a scroll div with a Spinner loading overlay. className goes on <table>, not wrapper. Sub-parts are separate named exports (shadcn-style). Uses `loading` (not isLoading like Button).

narrow.doc: Whether the cell uses narrow horizontal padding — pair with TableHead narrow for checkbox/icon columns.

TableCell.notes: Sub-component of Table (<td>). No colSpan/rowSpan passthrough.

TableExpandedRow.notes: Sub-component of Table. TableExpandedRow displays expanded content spanning all columns; use with TableRow's expanded prop. CSS-animated collapse.

narrow.doc: Whether the column should use narrow width (for checkboxes, icons)

TableHead.notes: Sub-component of Table (<th>). Sortable when onSort present; controlled sortDirection; aria-sort set.

TableRow.notes: Sub-component of Table. Controlled-only expansion (expanded prop, no toggle callback beyond onClick). Focusable + Enter/Space when onClick.

Alert.notes: Plain function, motion.div with role=alert (always, even for info). Note `icon` is a boolean toggle and the node goes in `customIcon` (inconsistent with Banner/FormHint where `icon` is the node).

dismissible.doc: Whether the banner can be dismissed

Banner.notes: Two axes: `type` = semantic intent, `variant` = fill style (unlike Alert where variant = intent). dismissible defaults TRUE (Alert defaults false). role=alert.

BannerCenterProvider.notes: Context provider + display. Imperative API via exported hook useBannerCenter(): { addBanner(banner: Omit<BannerItem,"id"> & { id?: string }) => string; removeBanner(id: string) => void; clearDismissible() => void; clearAll() => void }. BannerItem = { id; type?; variant?; title; description?; icon?; action?; dismissible? }. Shows non-dismissible banners in a row and only the newest dismissible one with skeleton stack hints.

Progress.notes: Plain function. value required even when indeterminate. Uses visually-hidden native <progress> for a11y.

Toast.notes: memo()-wrapped, motion.output aria-live=polite. No toast() imperative API/queue/auto-dismiss — consumer manages list and timing. Close naming: closable/onClose (vs Alert/Banner dismissible/onDismiss).

ToastContainer.notes: Portals to document.body; SSR-safe (returns null without document).

items.type: AccordionItemData[]  // { id: string; title: string; description?: string; content: ReactNode; disabled?: boolean; icon?: ReactNode }

multiple.doc: Allow multiple items to be expanded simultaneously

Accordion.notes: Data-driven (items array), not compound; internal AccordionItem is NOT exported. Controlled/uncontrolled: expanded / defaultExpanded / onExpandedChange(string[]). Arrow/Home/End roving between headers. Panel has role=region but no aria-controls/labelledby link.

firstDayOfWeek.doc: First day of week (0 = Sunday, 1 = Monday)

inline.doc: Render the calendar always-open, with no trigger button.

DatePicker.notes: Value effectively controlled-only (no defaultValue; selection not stored internally). onChange(value) not event. Open state is internal only (no open/onOpenChange). No label/name/form integration. Full keyboard grid nav (arrows, PageUp/Down, Shift+Page for year, Home/End).

files.type: UploadedFile[]  // { file: File; id: string; progress?: number; error?: string }

existingFiles.type: ExistingFile[]  // { id: string; name: string; size: number; contentType?: string; url?: string }
existingFiles.doc: Already-persisted files — rendered above the pending uploads.

onRemoveExisting.doc: Called when the X on an existing file row is clicked.

FileUpload.notes: Controlled-only file list (files + onFilesChange(full next array)); oversize files are added with an `error` string rather than rejected. Progress is consumer-driven via UploadedFile.progress. Hard-coded 'Choose files' text in button variant.

items.type: MultiSelectItem[]  // { id: string; label: ReactNode; description?: string; icon?: ReactNode; disabled?: boolean; divider?: boolean }

MultiSelect.notes: Controlled-only (value Set + onChange(Set)); no defaultValue. Trigger shows 'N selected'. Clear-all button. Menu not portaled. Item shape mirrors Dropdown's item shape (id/label/description/icon/disabled/divider).

value.type: ThemeName  // union of theme keys from themes/themes.ts

ThemeSwitcherGrid.notes: Controlled-only, onChange(value). role=radiogroup of role=radio buttons (no arrow-key roving). Iterates all registered themes.

items.type: BreadcrumbItem[]  // { label: ReactNode; href?: string; icon?: ReactNode }

Breadcrumb.notes: Data-driven. Plain <a href> only (no LinkComponent/router injection). Last item gets aria-current=page.

items.type: CommandItem[]  // { id: string; label: string; description?: string; icon?: ReactNode; shortcut?: string[]; group?: string; disabled?: boolean; onSelect?: () => void }

CommandPalette.notes: Native <dialog> showModal. Open state controlled-only via isOpen/onClose (no onOpenChange, no global ⌘K hotkey). Query state internal. Per-item onSelect callback; items grouped by `group`. Disabled items are hidden, not shown disabled.

NavLink.notes: Companion of Navbar (separate named export). Plain <a>, aria-current=page when active. No router injection.

Navbar.notes: <header>; mobile menu open state internal only. children rendered twice (desktop + mobile).

siblings.doc: Number of sibling pages to show

Pagination.notes: Controlled-only (page/onPageChange(number)). Returns null when totalPages <= 1. Arrow/Home/End on the nav.

Sidebar.notes: Context-based compound (separate named exports). Three modes: standalone uncontrolled, controlled (collapsed/onCollapsedChange — no defaultCollapsed), or inside SidebarProvider (provider state wins; onCollapsedChange NOT called on toggle via provider). <aside><nav aria-label=Primary>.

SidebarGroup.notes: Uncontrolled-only collapsible (defaultExpanded; no expanded/onExpandedChange). When sidebar collapsed, renders children flat.

SidebarHeader.notes: Header section for the sidebar, typically contains logo and toggle button. Reads collapsed from context.

LinkComponent.type: React.ComponentType<{ to: string; className?: string; "aria-current"?: "page" | undefined; onClick?: () => void; children: ReactNode }>
LinkComponent.doc: Custom link component for client-side routing (e.g., TanStack Router's Link)

SidebarItem.notes: Renders LinkComponent (to=href) / <a> / <button> depending on href+LinkComponent+disabled. Auto-closes mobile drawer on navigation. Label/badge hidden when collapsed (no tooltip).

SidebarLogo.notes: Logo component that auto-hides (returns null) when sidebar is collapsed.

SidebarMobileTrigger.notes: Hamburger menu button for opening the sidebar on mobile. Only renders when in responsive mobile mode (needs SidebarProvider to be used outside Sidebar).

SidebarProvider.notes: Provider for Sidebar context. Wrap your entire layout with this to allow SidebarMobileTrigger to work from outside the Sidebar. Owns collapsed/mobileOpen state (no controlled props). Also exports hook useSidebarContext(): { collapsed, variant, isMobile, mobileOpen, toggleCollapsed, toggleMobileOpen, closeMobile }. Locks body scroll + Escape closes when mobile open.

SidebarSection.notes: Arrow/Home/End focus roving across links/buttons inside. Title hidden when collapsed.

SidebarToggle.notes: Toggle button for collapsing/expanding the sidebar. On mobile, this becomes a close button. No custom icon/label props.

steps.type: StepData[]  // { id: string; label: string; description?: string; status?: "pending" | "active" | "completed" | "error"; clickable?: boolean }

onStepClick.doc: Callback when a step is clicked

StepIndicator.notes: forwardRef<HTMLDivElement> but no HTML passthrough. Status derived from currentStep unless step.status overrides. Steps clickable only when onStepClick provided and step.clickable !== false.

Tab.notes: Sub-component of Tabs. Uses `id` as the tab value (not `value`); DOM id is derived `${baseId}-tab-${id}`. Roving tabIndex.

aria-label.doc: Aria label for the tab list

TabList.notes: Sub-component of Tabs. role=tablist; Arrow/Home/End/Enter/Space handling; renders indicator.

TabPanel.notes: Sub-component of Tabs. Unmounts when inactive (no forceMount/keepMounted).

TabPanels.notes: Sub-component of Tabs. Plain wrapper div.

Tabs.notes: Context-based compound (separate named exports; sub-parts throw outside Tabs). Controlled/uncontrolled: activeTab / defaultTab / onTabChange(id) (non-standard names vs value/defaultValue/onValueChange). Animated sliding indicator for `line` variant (motion spring). Automatic activation (arrow keys move focus AND select).

size.doc: Width (desktop). Maps to CSS variable for the side drawer.

Drawer.notes: Drawer — side panel on desktop (>=768px, slides from right), bottom sheet on mobile. Portals to body; role=dialog aria-modal but no focus trap / focus restore. Controlled-only open (isOpen/onClose). No `side` prop. No displayName set.

items.type: DropdownItem[]  // { id: string; label: ReactNode; description?: string; icon?: ReactNode; disabled?: boolean; danger?: boolean; divider?: boolean }

placement.doc: Whether the menu opens above or below the trigger

triggerAriaLabel.doc: Accessible label for the trigger button (use when trigger has no visible text)

iconOnly.doc: Remove min-width from trigger — use when trigger is icon-only

Dropdown.notes: Custom single-select (listbox semantics but items use role=menuitem — mixed). value controlled-only, onChange(id) (no defaultValue). Open state internal. `trigger` replaces trigger CONTENT inside its own <button> (not asChild). Not portaled; CSS-positioned.

items.type: MenuItem[]  // MenuItemData { id: string; label: string; sublabel?: string; state?: "default" | "active" | "disabled"; leftIcon?: ReactNode; rightIcon?: ReactNode; checkbox?: boolean; checked?: boolean; shortcut?: string; onClick?: () => void } | MenuDivider { type: "divider"; label?: string }

open.doc: Whether the menu is open. Defaults to `true` — most callers (e.g. `Popover`) already mount/unmount `DropdownMenu` conditionally. Pass it explicitly when mounted once and toggled in place, so its own enter/exit animation has something to react to.

onItemClick.doc: Callback when an item is clicked

DropdownMenu.notes: forwardRef<HTMLDivElement> (ref on the motion.div menu surface). A menu SURFACE only — no trigger; compose inside Popover (unstyled). Item state is an enum `state` instead of disabled/active booleans. Per-item onClick plus menu-level onItemClick. Checkbox items are display-only (checked is consumer-driven).

dismissible.doc: Whether the modal can be dismissed by clicking overlay or pressing Escape

Modal.notes: Native <dialog>.showModal() (browser focus trap + top layer); close deferred until exit animation completes. Controlled-only (isOpen/onClose). Hard-coded ids 'modal-title'/'modal-description' (collide with multiple modals). Close button hidden when !dismissible. Slot props title/description/icon/footer, no compound parts.

unstyled.doc: Skip Popover's own card chrome (background/border/shadow/radius) and the body's padding. Use when `children` is already a fully-surfaced component (e.g. `DropdownMenu`).

Popover.notes: Controlled/uncontrolled: open / onOpenChange(boolean), no defaultOpen. Trigger: if a valid element, cloneElement injects ref/onClick/onKeyDown/aria-* (asChild-like, overrides trigger's ref); otherwise wrapped in a <button>. CSS-positioned, not portaled, no collision handling. trapFocus only focuses first element (not a real trap). Close naming: showClose (vs showCloseButton in Modal/Drawer).

Tooltip.notes: CSS-only (hover/focus-within). No delay, no controlled open, no aria-describedby wiring to trigger. Uses `position` (Popover uses `placement`).
